$comment: Copyright (c) 2026 Algod DAO. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. bench-compare result schema v1 (issue #2102, epic #2101). A tier writes one or more *.json files into $BENCH_OUT; each file holds one result object or an array of them. Validated by scripts/bench/bench_schema.py, which implements the keyword subset used here (type, const, enum, pattern, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, minimum, minLength). See docs/BENCHMARK_COMPARISON.md 'Tier contract'.
title: bench-compare result (v1)

schema.description: Schema id and version. A breaking change adds result-v2.json; it never edits this file.

tier.description: Tier that produced the result; equals the tier script's basename.

name.description: Benchmark name, identical for the Go and Rust halves of a pair (the pairing key is tier + name).

unit.description: Unit of every sample, e.g. ns/op, s, MB/s, txn/s, bytes. Both halves of a pair must use the same unit.

better.description: Optional direction. Default: 'higher' when the unit ends in '/s', otherwise 'lower'.

samples.description: One value per measured run (warm-up runs excluded), in run order.

metadata.description: Free-form provenance: input corpus + sha256, binary or package, command line, iterations, final-state hash for macro tiers, synthetic=true for selftest rows.
